content.Title: 2021 Chest Pain Guideline
content.Source: Gulati et al., JACC Vol 78, No 22, 2021
content.General Information: The guideline provides an overview of diagnostic testing and cost-value considerations for managing chest pain. It includes sections on CCTA, CAC scanning, exercise electrocardiographic tests, and stress echocardiography. The document discusses economic outcomes and the effectiveness of various diagnostic strategies for coronary artery disease.
